other_failure_modes.name: Threshold Optimization Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The decision thresholds for mapping continuous predictions to discrete classes are optimized on the entire Out-Of-Fold (OOF) predictions array, and then the model is evaluated on these exact same predictions. This leaks validation information into the thresholding process and artificially inflates the reported validation score.

other_failure_modes.name: CV Feature Engineering Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Several feature engineering steps (TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and group aggregations like mean/std/min/max) are fitted or computed on the entire training dataset before the cross-validation split. This leaks information from the validation folds into the training folds, making the cross-validation score unreliable.

other_failure_modes.name: Dead Code / Unused Blend Optimizer
other_failure_modes.description: The agent defines a function to mathematically optimize ensemble weights based on OOF predictions, but never actually calls it in the execution pipeline, falling back to hardcoded arbitrary weights.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution leveraging regression with optimized threshold rounding, which is ideal for the QWK metric. However, it introduces data leakage by applying TF-IDF, SVD, and group aggregations on the entire training set before cross-validation. Additionally, it overfits its validation score by optimizing the rounding thresholds on the full OOF predictions and then evaluating on those same predictions.
